meta.name: spa-blueprint-design-tokens
meta.notes: Canonical token values for spa-REQ-003, spa-REQ-005, spa-REQ-012, and spa-REQ-020. Colour pairings are contrast-validated: text tokens meet 4.5:1 and border/focus tokens meet 3:1 against every surface token in their theme. Parity rule: the light and dark colour key sets must remain identical; a key present in one theme and not the other is a defect (AC-1106-2).

usage.onSurface: Body and heading text on any surface token.
usage.onSurfaceMuted: Secondary text; still passes 4.5:1 on every surface.
usage.primary: Primary actions and links; text-safe on surfaces; pair fills with onPrimary.
usage.accent: Highlights and selected states; text-safe on surfaces.
usage.danger: Destructive actions and error text; pair fills with onDanger.
usage.warning: Cautionary text and indicators; text-safe on surfaces.
usage.success: Positive confirmation text and indicators; text-safe on surfaces.
usage.border: Form-control and component boundaries (3:1 floor, WCAG 1.4.11).
usage.divider: Decorative separation only; never a control boundary.
usage.focusRing: Focus indicator colour (3:1 floor against surfaces).

spacing.notes: All margins, paddings, and gaps resolve to this scale (AC-1104-1). Section spacing defaults: space-12 between page sections, space-6 within a section, space-2 between a label and its control.

radius.notes: radius-sm for inputs and small controls, radius-md for cards and overlays, radius-lg for prominent surfaces, radius-full for pills and avatars.

fontFamily.ui: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fontFamily.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, monospace

typography.notes: text-body resolves to at least 14px below 768 viewport width and at least 16px at 768 and above (AC-1127-2); clamp() carries the fluid scaling (AC-1127-3). Sizes above body follow the 1.25 modular scale.

dark.notes: Dark elevation pairs shadow with a faint outline plus the raised surface tokens so hierarchy survives without light-theme shadow contrast (AC-1106-5).

motion.notes: Defaults per ADR-207: enter and state changes use ease-out at motion-base; exits use motion-fast. prefers-reduced-motion collapses all of these (see theme.css).

breakpoints.notes: The ratified baseline breakpoints (spa-REQ-004). Container widths per breakpoint live in assets/viewports.md.

targetSize.notes: Minimum interactive target per WCAG 2.2 and AC-1126-4; controls may render visually smaller only when padding or spacing preserves the 24x24 target.
